title: On Linux and other Unix-like systems, LibreOffice can send the current document as an email attachment with File >…
description: A command injection vulnerability exists in LibreOffice on Linux and Unix-like systems when using the 'Send > Email Document' feature. The vulnerability arises because the script that launches the mail client allows the shell to interpret the document's file name, enabling execution of arbitrary commands if the file name is crafted maliciously. This issue has been addressed in fixed versions by passing the file name and other parameters as plain arguments to the mail client, preventing shell interpretation.
